notes.title: Magnetis demo available
notes.notes:
Those who prefer trying before buying will be pleased to learn that a free demo is now available at this adress: http://store.steampowered.com/app/37510/

This demo includes the time attack mode with online leaderboards and a few achievements.

notes.title: Yullaby adds online leaderboards and 40 achievements to Magnetis!
notes.notes:
The race for the world's best score is on, thanks to Magnetis'latest update, exclusively on Steam. 
On top of regular scores sharing, the addition of a metascore will highlight allaround Magnetis champions (http://steamcommunity.com/stats/Magnetis/leaderboards/).
Morevoer, with the addition of 40 achievements to unlock, players will discover the game under a new light! (http://steamcommunity.com/stats/Magnetis/achievements/)
